reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text substantiates the preferred position: Section 6.0 does not authorize production/delivery absent an order, Section 11.2(d) states forecasts 'do not obligate IBM to purchase any Product', Section 6.1 permits cancellation of any and all Purchase Orders at any time, and Section 13.2(e) disclaims liability for unused flexibility — i.e., no take-or-pay, no volume floor.

The only volume-linked exposure (Section 13.0(f) / Appendix 2 requirements-accuracy compensation) is correctly characterized as a reliance-based true-up for MSL's inventory purchases rather than a shortfall penalty or minimum commitment; under the playbook this sits at or above the fallback, so no redline is warranted and the diligence note on the redacted percentages is an appropriate rationale-level observation.
No deterministic check failures; rationale is accurate to the quoted language and does not overstate the protections.
